name: fms related receptor tyrosine kinase 1
pathways: positive regulation of MAP kinase activity
positive regulation of phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase/protein kinase B signal transduction

function.text: FLT1 encodes vascular endothelial growth factor receptor 1. Annotated molecular activities include protein tyrosine kinase activity and transmembrane receptor protein tyrosine kinase activity. It participates in positive regulation of MAP kinase activity and positive regulation of phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase/protein kinase B signal transduction.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.

function.text: FLT1 encodes vascular endothelial growth factor receptor 1. Based in part on similarity, it functions as a positive regulator of postnatal retinal hyaloid vessel regression. May play an essential role as a negative regulator of embryonic angiogenesis by inhibiting excessive proliferation of endothelial cells. It can promote endothelial cell proliferation, survival and angiogenesis in adulthood.
